candidates.hypothesis: Inclusion misses concentrate at ~34px (low-tertile recall 0.158, n=146); shrinking pastes to 0.3-0.5x source size (~27-45px) will raise inclusion AP50 and small-tertile recall beyond the 0.3-0.7 band. Confirmed if inclusion AP50 clearly exceeds 0.386 and mAP50 > 0.60 vs control; if inclusion AP drops, the floor is too small/noisy and I stop at 0.3-0.7.

Selecting smaller source defects (prefer_small) shifts the synthetic size distribution toward the missed band independently of the scale multiplier, improving small-tertile recall across all three classes (all show the same small-miss pattern). Confirmed if mAP50 > 0.60 with inclusion AP50 up and patches/scratches AP50 not below control; if it ties C1, scale is the better smallness lever.

With small scale proven, allocation becomes the active lever again: 5 extra inclusion images (30 vs 25) at the expense of patches (15->10, already strongest at 0.76) will raise inclusion AP50 without materially hurting patches. Confirmed if inclusion AP50 rises and patches AP50 stays >= ~0.74; if patches drop >0.03, allocation is not worth the trade and I keep 25/15/10 in round 3.
